relay_arrival_shadow_choice.note: One ready request against 10,000 routes and 32 candidates; route loading is excluded and shared with ordinary wake admission.

notes: All timings are local lower bounds and exclude UCloud, registry, and sandbox-node I/O.
The full 10,000-by-32 plan runs only in the periodic autoscaler cycle; relay arrivals compute one O(nodes) shadow choice.
The benchmark intentionally uses homogeneous small sandboxes to force the planner to place all 10,000 entries.
Production acceptance still requires representative heterogeneous shapes, wake storms, and the control-host persistent mount.
